data.name: Lottie
data.long_meaning: The name Lottie is derived from the Old English word 'lott,' which means 'little' or 'compact.' In the Middle Ages, it was used as a pet form of various female names beginning with 'L.' Today, Lottie is primarily used as a feminine given name, often associated with lovability and cuteness.
